datasets.name: ops_headline
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS total_stations_observed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN availability_status = 'AVAILABLE'            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS available_stations,
  SUM(CASE WHEN availability_status = 'OUT_OF_SERVICE'        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_service_stations,
  SUM(CASE WHEN availability_status = 'LOW_BIKES'             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_bike_stations,
  SUM(CASE WHEN availability_status = 'LOW_DOCKS'             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_dock_stations,
  SUM(CASE WHEN availability_status = 'LOW_BIKES_AND_DOCKS'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both_low_stations,
  SUM(CASE WHEN availability_status IN ('LOW_BIKES','LOW_DOCKS','LOW_BIKES_AND_DOCKS')
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                       AS actionable_shortages,
  MIN(observed_at)                                                  AS snapshot_observed_from,
  MAX(observed_at)                                                  AS snapshot_observed_to,
  COUNT(DISTINCT execution_id)                                      AS executions_included,
  'one GBFS snapshot - a point-in-time count, not a trend'           AS reading_note
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_station_status

datasets.name: ops_breakdown
queryLines:
SELECT
  availability_status,
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS stations,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2)                AS percent_of_stations
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_station_status
GROUP BY availability_status
ORDER BY stations DESC

datasets.name: ops_priorities
queryLines:
SELECT
  p.priority_score,
  p.action,
  p.station_name,
  p.station_id,
  p.availability_status,
  p.num_bikes_available,
  p.num_docks_available,
  p.capacity_estimate,
  p.severity_points,
  p.deficit_points,
  p.size_points,
  p.observed_at,
  CASE WHEN m.open_tickets > 0 THEN 'HOLD - open maintenance ticket' ELSE 'clear' END
                                                                    AS maintenance_hold
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.gold_rebalancing_priority AS p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT station_id, COUNT(*) AS open_tickets
  FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_station_maintenance
  WHERE status <> 'CLOSED'
  GROUP BY station_id
) AS m
  ON p.station_id = m.station_id
ORDER BY p.priority_score DESC, p.num_bikes_available ASC
LIMIT 25

datasets.name: ops_actions
queryLines:
SELECT
  action,
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS stations,
  ROUND(AVG(priority_score), 2)                                     AS avg_priority_score,
  MAX(priority_score)                                               AS worst_priority_score
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.gold_rebalancing_priority
GROUP BY action
ORDER BY stations DESC

datasets.name: demand_daily
queryLines:
SELECT
  execution_id,
  CASE WHEN execution_id LIKE 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40%'
       THEN '40-ROW DEVELOPMENT SAMPLE' ELSE 'FULL ARCHIVE EXECUTION' END AS data_scope,
  trip_date,
  SUM(trips_started)                                                AS trips,
  SUM(member_trips)                                                 AS member_trips,
  SUM(casual_trips)                                                  AS casual_trips,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_trip_minutes), 2)                                   AS avg_trip_minutes,
  COUNT(DISTINCT station_short_name)                                AS stations_with_trips
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.gold_daily_trip_demand
WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40'
GROUP BY execution_id, trip_date
ORDER BY execution_id, trip_date

datasets.name: demand_hourly
queryLines:
SELECT
  execution_id,
  CASE WHEN execution_id LIKE 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40%'
       THEN '40-ROW DEVELOPMENT SAMPLE' ELSE 'FULL ARCHIVE EXECUTION' END AS data_scope,
  DATE_FORMAT(started_at, 'EEEE')                                   AS day_of_week,
  DAYOFWEEK(started_at)                                             AS day_of_week_number,
  HOUR(started_at)                                                  AS hour_of_day,
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS trips,
  SUM(CASE WHEN member_casual = 'member' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)         AS member_trips,
  SUM(CASE WHEN member_casual = 'casual' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)         AS casual_trips
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_historical_trips
WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY execution_id, day_of_week_number, hour_of_day

datasets.name: demand_durations
queryLines:
SELECT
  execution_id,
  CASE WHEN execution_id LIKE 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40%'
       THEN '40-ROW DEVELOPMENT SAMPLE' ELSE 'FULL ARCHIVE EXECUTION' END AS data_scope,
  CASE
    WHEN duration_minutes <  1   THEN '00 under 1 min (false start)'
    WHEN duration_minutes <  5   THEN '01 1-5 min'
    WHEN duration_minutes < 15   THEN '02 5-15 min'
    WHEN duration_minutes < 30   THEN '03 15-30 min'
    WHEN duration_minutes < 60   THEN '04 30-60 min'
    WHEN duration_minutes < 1440 THEN '05 1-24 hours'
    ELSE                              '06 over 24 hours (not returned)'
  END                                                               AS duration_bucket,
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS trips,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY execution_id), 2
  )                                                                 AS percent_of_trips
FROM (
  SELECT execution_id,
         (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(ended_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(started_at)) / 60.0 AS duration_minutes
  FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_historical_trips
  WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40'
)
GROUP BY execution_id, duration_bucket
ORDER BY execution_id, duration_bucket

datasets.name: demand_headline
queryLines:
SELECT
  execution_id,
  CASE WHEN execution_id LIKE 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40%'
       THEN '40-ROW DEVELOPMENT SAMPLE' ELSE 'FULL ARCHIVE EXECUTION' END AS data_scope,
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS valid_trips,
  SUM(CASE WHEN member_casual = 'member' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)         AS member_trips,
  SUM(CASE WHEN member_casual = 'casual' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)         AS casual_trips,
  COUNT(DISTINCT start_station_id)                                  AS distinct_start_stations,
  MIN(started_at)                                                   AS first_ride_started,
  MAX(ended_at)                                                     AS last_ride_ended
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_historical_trips
WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40'
GROUP BY execution_id

datasets.name: demand_rideable
queryLines:
SELECT
  execution_id,
  rideable_type,
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS trips,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY execution_id), 2) AS percent_of_trips
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_historical_trips
WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40'
GROUP BY execution_id, rideable_type
ORDER BY execution_id, trips DESC

datasets.name: demand_top_stations
queryLines:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT execution_id, 'origin' AS direction, start_station_name AS station_name,
         start_station_id AS station_short_name, COUNT(*) AS trips
  FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_historical_trips
  WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40' AND start_station_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 15
)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT execution_id, 'destination' AS direction, end_station_name AS station_name,
         end_station_id AS station_short_name, COUNT(*) AS trips
  FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_historical_trips
  WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40' AND end_station_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: demand_day_type
queryLines:
SELECT
  execution_id,
  CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(started_at) IN (1, 7) THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT TO_DATE(started_at))                               AS days,
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS trips,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT TO_DATE(started_at)), 0)          AS avg_trips_per_day,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN member_casual = 'casual' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2)
                                                                    AS casual_percent
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_historical_trips
WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40'
  AND started_at >= TIMESTAMP'2024-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY execution_id, day_type
ORDER BY execution_id, day_type

datasets.name: weather_daily
queryLines:
SELECT
  execution_id,
  CASE WHEN execution_id LIKE 'urbanflow-final-weather-devsample48h%'
       THEN '48-HOUR WEATHER / 40-TRIP DEVELOPMENT SAMPLE'
       ELSE 'FULL ARCHIVE WEATHER EXECUTION' END                    AS data_scope,
  trip_date,
  SUM(trips)                                                        AS trips,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_temperature_celsius), 2)                            AS avg_temperature_celsius,
  ROUND(SUM(total_precipitation_mm), 2)                             AS total_precipitation_mm,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_wind_speed_kmh), 2)                                 AS avg_wind_speed_kmh,
  ROUND(AVG(weather_coverage), 4)                                   AS weather_coverage
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.gold_weather_demand
WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-weather-devsample48h'
GROUP BY execution_id, trip_date
ORDER BY execution_id, trip_date

datasets.name: weather_buckets
queryLines:
SELECT
  execution_id,
  CASE WHEN execution_id LIKE 'urbanflow-final-weather-devsample48h%'
       THEN '48-HOUR WEATHER / 40-TRIP DEVELOPMENT SAMPLE'
       ELSE 'FULL ARCHIVE WEATHER EXECUTION' END                    AS data_scope,
  temperature_bucket,
  SUM(trips)                                                        AS trips,
  COUNT(DISTINCT trip_date)                                         AS days_in_bucket,
  ROUND(SUM(trips) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT trip_date), 0), 1)       AS avg_trips_per_day,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_temperature_celsius), 2)                            AS avg_temperature_celsius
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.gold_weather_demand
WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-weather-devsample48h'
GROUP BY execution_id, temperature_bucket
ORDER BY execution_id, temperature_bucket

datasets.name: weather_precipitation
queryLines:
SELECT
  execution_id,
  CASE WHEN execution_id LIKE 'urbanflow-final-weather-devsample48h%'
       THEN '48-HOUR WEATHER / 40-TRIP DEVELOPMENT SAMPLE'
       ELSE 'FULL ARCHIVE WEATHER EXECUTION' END                    AS data_scope,
  CASE
    WHEN total_precipitation_mm IS NULL   THEN 'unknown'
    WHEN total_precipitation_mm =  0      THEN '0 dry'
    WHEN total_precipitation_mm <  2      THEN '1 light (under 2 mm)'
    WHEN total_precipitation_mm < 10      THEN '2 moderate (2-10 mm)'
    ELSE                                       '3 heavy (10 mm or more)'
  END                                                               AS precipitation_band,
  COUNT(DISTINCT trip_date)                                         AS days,
  SUM(trips)                                                        AS trips,
  ROUND(SUM(trips) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT trip_date), 0), 1)       AS avg_trips_per_day
FROM (
  SELECT execution_id, trip_date, SUM(trips) AS trips,
         SUM(total_precipitation_mm) AS total_precipitation_mm
  FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.gold_weather_demand
  WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-weather-devsample48h'
  GROUP BY execution_id, trip_date
)
GROUP BY execution_id, precipitation_band
ORDER BY execution_id, precipitation_band

datasets.name: weather_series
queryLines:
WITH selected_window AS (
  SELECT MIN(trip_date) AS starts_on, MAX(trip_date) AS ends_on
  FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.gold_weather_demand
  WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-weather-devsample48h'
)
SELECT
  'urbanflow-final-weather-devsample48h'                                             AS execution_id,
  weather_grid_label,
  MIN(weather_hour)                                                 AS covers_from,
  MAX(weather_hour)                                                 AS covers_to,
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS hours_retrieved,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_temperature   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                AS hours_with_temperature,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_precipitation THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                AS hours_with_precipitation,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_wind          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                AS hours_with_wind,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT has_temperature THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)              AS missing_temperature_hours,
  MAX(source)                                                       AS source,
  MAX(retrieved_at)                                                 AS retrieved_at
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.dim_weather_hourly
CROSS JOIN selected_window
WHERE TO_DATE(weather_hour) BETWEEN starts_on AND ends_on
GROUP BY weather_grid_label

datasets.name: weather_gaps
queryLines:
SELECT
  execution_id,
  CASE WHEN execution_id LIKE 'urbanflow-final-weather-devsample48h%'
       THEN '48-HOUR WEATHER / 40-TRIP DEVELOPMENT SAMPLE'
       ELSE 'FULL ARCHIVE WEATHER EXECUTION' END                    AS data_scope,
  SUM(trips)                                                        AS trips,
  SUM(trips_with_weather)                                           AS trips_with_weather,
  SUM(trips) - SUM(trips_with_weather)                              AS trips_without_weather,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(trips_with_weather) / NULLIF(SUM(trips), 0), 2) AS weather_coverage_percent,
  COUNT(DISTINCT trip_date)                                         AS days_covered
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.gold_weather_demand
WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-weather-devsample48h'
GROUP BY execution_id
ORDER BY execution_id

datasets.name: quality_station
queryLines:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.bronze_station_status)     AS bronze_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_station_status)     AS silver_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.quarantine_station_status) AS quarantine_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.duplicate_station_status)  AS duplicate_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.fact_station_availability) AS fact_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.gold_station_shortage)     AS shortage_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.gold_rebalancing_priority) AS priority_rows
)
SELECT
  *,
  silver_rows + quarantine_rows + duplicate_rows                    AS accounted_rows,
  bronze_rows = silver_rows + quarantine_rows + duplicate_rows      AS bronze_reconciles,
  fact_rows = silver_rows                                           AS fact_matches_silver,
  shortage_rows = priority_rows                                     AS derived_tables_agree
FROM counts

datasets.name: quality_trip_rules
queryLines:
SELECT
  execution_id,
  rule                                                              AS failed_rule,
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS trips_failing
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.quarantine_historical_trips
LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(failed_rules) exploded AS rule
WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40'
GROUP BY execution_id, rule
ORDER BY trips_failing DESC

datasets.name: quality_lakeflow
queryLines:
SELECT
  expectation.dataset                                               AS dataset,
  expectation.name                                                  AS expectation,
  SUM(expectation.passed_records)                                   AS passed_records,
  SUM(expectation.failed_records)                                   AS failed_records
FROM (
  SELECT EXPLODE(FROM_JSON(
           details:flow_progress.data_quality.expectations,
           'ARRAY<STRUCT<name: STRING, dataset: STRING, passed_records: BIGINT, failed_records: BIGINT>>'
         )) AS expectation
  FROM EVENT_LOG(TABLE(workspace.urbanflow_final_lakeflow_dev.silver_station_status))
  WHERE event_type = 'flow_progress'
    AND details:flow_progress.data_quality.expectations IS NOT NULL
    AND origin.update_id = (
      SELECT origin.update_id
      FROM EVENT_LOG(TABLE(workspace.urbanflow_final_lakeflow_dev.silver_station_status))
      WHERE event_type = 'update_progress' AND details:update_progress.state = 'COMPLETED'
      ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
    )
)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY dataset, expectation

datasets.name: quality_monthly
queryLines:
SELECT
  'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40'                                          AS execution_id,
  landed_rows,
  valid_trips,
  quarantined_trips,
  duplicate_trips,
  landed_rows = valid_trips + quarantined_trips + duplicate_trips   AS reconciles,
  matched_trips,
  ROUND(100.0 * matched_trips / NULLIF(valid_trips, 0), 2)          AS reference_coverage_percent,
  'coverage of the 40-station development reference dimension, not data quality' AS reading_note
FROM (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.bronze_historical_trips)
                                                                    AS landed_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_historical_trips
     WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40')                 AS valid_trips,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.quarantine_historical_trips
     WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40')                 AS quarantined_trips,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.duplicate_historical_trips
     WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40')                 AS duplicate_trips,
    (SELECT SUM(trips_started) FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.gold_daily_trip_demand
     WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40' AND start_station_uuid IS NOT NULL)
                                                                    AS matched_trips

datasets.name: maintenance_status
queryLines:
SELECT
  status,
  severity,
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS tickets,
  MAX(updated_at)                                                   AS last_updated_at,
  'FICTIONAL, SYNTHETIC MAINTENANCE DATA'                           AS data_scope
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_station_maintenance
GROUP BY status, severity
ORDER BY status, severity

datasets.name: maintenance_conflicts
datasets.displayName: Stations with an open maintenance ticket
queryLines:
SELECT
  m.maintenance_id,
  COALESCE(d.station_name, '(not in the 40-station development sample)') AS station_name,
  m.status                                                          AS maintenance_status,
  m.severity                                                        AS maintenance_severity,
  m.updated_at                                                      AS maintenance_updated_at,
  s.availability_status,
  p.priority_score,
  p.action,
  CASE WHEN p.station_id IS NULL THEN 'no rebalancing action pending'
       ELSE 'HOLD - dispatcher decision before sending a van' END    AS dispatch_note
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_station_maintenance AS m
LEFT JOIN workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.dim_station_development_sample AS d
  ON m.station_id = d.station_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT station_id, availability_status FROM (
    SELECT station_id, availability_status,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY station_id ORDER BY observed_at DESC) AS position
    FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.silver_station_status
  ) WHERE position = 1
) AS s
  ON m.station_id = s.station_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT station_id, priority_score, action FROM (
    SELECT station_id, priority_score, action,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY station_id ORDER BY observed_at DESC) AS position
    FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.gold_rebalancing_priority
  ) WHERE position = 1
) AS p
  ON m.station_id = p.station_id
WHERE m.status <> 'CLOSED'
ORDER BY p.priority_score DESC NULLS LAST,
         CASE m.severity WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
         m.maintenance_id

datasets.name: maintenance_cdc
queryLines:
SELECT
  commit_version,
  change_type,
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS events,
  MIN(commit_timestamp)                                             AS committed_at
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.maintenance_cdc_history
GROUP BY commit_version, change_type
ORDER BY commit_version, change_type

datasets.name: maintenance_checkpoint
queryLines:
SELECT
  c.pipeline_key,
  c.processed_version,
  c.processed_at,
  (SELECT MAX(commit_version) FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.maintenance_cdc_history)
                                                                    AS last_data_change_version,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.maintenance_cdc_history) AS history_events
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.maintenance_cdc_checkpoint AS c

datasets.name: assistant_evaluation
queryLines:
SELECT
  variant,
  COUNT(*)                                                          AS questions,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(get_json_object(metrics_json, '$.answer_correctness') AS DOUBLE)), 3)
                                                                    AS answer_correctness,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(get_json_object(metrics_json, '$.retrieval_recall') AS DOUBLE)), 3)
                                                                    AS retrieval_recall,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(get_json_object(metrics_json, '$.source_coverage') AS DOUBLE)), 3)
                                                                    AS source_coverage,
  SUM(CASE WHEN error_status IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)         AS errors,
  MAX(evaluated_at)                                                 AS evaluated_at
FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.rag_evaluation_results
WHERE evaluation_id = (
  SELECT evaluation_id FROM workspace.urbanflow_final_dev.rag_evaluation_results
  ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY variant
ORDER BY variant

lines: **POINT-IN-TIME GBFS SNAPSHOT — NOT A HISTORICAL AVAILABILITY TREND.** The station executions loaded into this target (by default the committed, dated Citi Bike sample snapshot). Nothing on this page is charted over time.
**Actionable = LOW_BIKES + LOW_DOCKS + LOW_BIKES_AND_DOCKS.** An OUT_OF_SERVICE station is excluded: no rebalancing fixes it.

frame.title: Top 25 rebalancing priorities (score = severity + deficit + size; HOLD = open maintenance ticket)

lines: **REAL JANUARY 2024 CITI BIKE TRIPS** — every valid trip of execution `urbanflow-final-hist-devsample40` only. With the Job defaults this is the **40-ROW DEVELOPMENT SAMPLE**, so the counts illustrate the pipeline, not the month; each dataset carries its `data_scope` label. The archive is defined by ride END time.

frame.title: Average trips per day: weekday vs weekend
Trips by hour of day (UTC timestamps as stored)

lines: Hourly Open-Meteo archive for **one NYC reference coordinate** (40.7128, -74.0060) — **not station-level weather**. Charts show **association, not causation**: nothing controls for weekday, holidays or closures. Weather execution `urbanflow-final-weather-devsample48h`; trips outside its window have no weather and are counted, not hidden.

frame.title: Average trips per day by temperature band
Average trips per day by rainfall band

lines: Reconciliation identities for this target's executions and the Lakeflow expectations of the latest COMPLETED update of its isolated pipeline. Run IDs and results are recorded as evidence only after a live run.

**A low reference coverage is NOT a data-quality failure.** It is the share of rides starting at one of the 40 stations in the committed **DEVELOPMENT REFERENCE DIMENSION**, while the real network has thousands of stations. Landed = valid + quarantine + duplicates must hold exactly.

frame.title: Why trips were quarantined (every row has a named reason)
Station snapshot reconciliation (Bronze = Silver + Quarantine + Duplicates)
Lakeflow expectations from the pipeline event log (latest completed update)

lines: Station maintenance arrives through **Delta Change Data Feed**; the tickets are **FICTIONAL, SYNTHETIC DATA** on real sample station IDs. Assistant scores come only from approved **live** evaluations; offline fixture scores are never stored, so empty tables mean no live evaluation has run.

CDC audit trail by source version
